title: The prime subfield of a field is countable
statement: Let $L$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $P\subseteq L$ be its prime subfield, namely the intersection of all subfields of $L$ (the smallest subfield containing $1$). Then $|P|\leq\aleph_0$, where $|P|$ is the cardinality of its underlying set and $\aleph_0=|\mathbf N|$, with cardinalities in a common universe.

source.place: Tag 09FR (definition-characteristic), preceding paragraphs identify the prime subfield with the rational field or a finite prime field; countability consequence. Mathlib/SetTheory/Cardinal/Subfield.lean:73 gives the more general generated-subfield cardinal bound.
